a.lede: A banking malware operation active since mid-2025 has been using a toolkit named KREMLIN to install malicious Chrome and Edge extensions that steal credentials, session tokens, and sensitive data. [...]
a.title: Malware bypasses browser checks to force install Chrome, Edge extensions

b.lede: The Pixel phone maker said there are indications that a bug in the phone's modem "may be under limited, targeted exploitation."
b.title: Google says some Pixel phone owners were hacked in zero-day attacks
